lastCompletedStory.title: Emit the split advisory at plan-time (non-gating)

nextStoryContext: maybeEmitPlanSplitAdvisory (src/supervisor/plan-split-advisory.ts) is now wired into runPostPlanActions (src/commands/sidecar.ts) strictly AFTER exitPhaseAfterPlan, so the split advisory can never affect the plan/post-audit outcome or phase transition. It reads the just-planned issue's wsjf.jobSize via issueFilePath(`CAM-${issueNumber}`), the generated prd.json's userStories.length as storyCount, and builds historical { jobSize, total } records by joining aggregateTokensPerIssue's (src/stats/tokens.ts, US-001) perIssue rollups with issueFilePath(rollup.issueNumber)'s own jobSize -- note rollup.issueNumber is already a 'CAM-N' id string (sourced from JournalCycleEntry.issue via recordCycleTokens), not a bare number, so no reformatting is needed there (only the CURRENT issue needs the `CAM-${n}` string build, since prd.json's issueNumber is a bare number). When computeSplitAdvisory (US-003) fires, it emits the 'plan-split-advisory' event via o.logEvent AND pushes an operator note via makeNotifyOrchestrator (same notify factory runPostAuditAction already uses). The ENTIRE function body is wrapped in one try/catch so any read/parse/join/notify/logEvent failure is swallowed silently -- verified with dedicated tests for a throwing notify, a throwing logEvent, a missing issue file, a missing prd.json, and a non-numeric issueNumber, all returning normally with zero emission. No project.toml knob was added (threshold + bucketing remain the US-003 code constants). Raised src/commands/sidecar.ts's file-size ceiling 3112->3128 for the import + call site (the ~50-line computation itself lives in the new module, not inline, to avoid a much larger ceiling raise -- see the new patterns.md bullet on this extraction choice). PRD (CAM-241/136) is now fully implemented: this was the last non-operator story (US-001 through US-004, priorities 1-4). No further stories remain; the next agent invocation should see PRD_COMPLETE from the supervisor.
